title: Senior systemutvecklare C/C++ till cybersäkerhet, Linköping
description:
Vi söker en erfaren senior systemutvecklare för ett konsultuppdrag hos vår kund i Linköping. Kunden är verksam inom cybersäkerhet och säker kommunikation och utvecklar tekniskt avancerade produkter för miljöer med höga krav på informationssäkerhet.
  
Det här är ett uppdrag för dig som har ett brett perspektiv på systemutveckling och vill förstå helheten – inte enbart fokusera på enskilda utvecklingsuppgifter.
  
Om uppdraget
  
  

Du arbetar med vidareutveckling av en befintlig produkt i en tekniskt komplex miljö. Utvecklingen sker huvudsakligen i C/C++ och Windowsmiljö, men även Linux förekommer.
  
Du rör dig mellan olika team och bidrar med ett brett tekniskt perspektiv. En viktig del är att sätta enskilda utvecklingsuppgifter i ett större sammanhang och förstå hur tekniska beslut påverkar systemet och produkten som helhet.
  
Du arbetar nära team lead och tech lead och förväntas bidra i diskussioner kring design, tekniska lösningar och vägval. Det här är inte en renodlad implementationsroll.
  
Krav
  
Erfarenhet som systemutvecklare på erfaren medior- eller seniornivå
  
God och bred förståelse för systemutveckling och förmåga att se systemet som helhet
  
Erfarenhet av utveckling i C/C++
  
Erfarenhet av utveckling i Windowsmiljö
  
Erfarenhet av Linux
  
Förmåga att bidra i tekniska diskussioner, design och vägval
  
Förmåga att arbeta nära team lead och tech lead
  
Förmåga att arbeta flexibelt över flera team
  
Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska
  
Svenskt medborgarskap
  
  

Skicka CV och några rader om dig till info@ndpconsult.se. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande.

title: Network Programmer
description:
Are you passionate about creating seamless and robust multiplayer experiences? Join our innovative team in Stockholm as a Network Programmer to shape the online backbone for an ambitious new game currently in active development.
   

  

 As a Network Programmer, you will be crucial in ensuring our multiplayer experience is technically sound, reliable, and ready for deployment. Your mission will be to build, optimize, and maintain the networking infrastructure that powers our game's online features.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Designing, developing, and maintaining scalable networking libraries for core multiplayer features
* Collaborating closely with various disciplines to define requirements and align on technical implementations
* Refactoring existing solutions and transforming prototype features into production-ready systems
* Identifying and addressing technical shortcomings in our networking approach with well-engineered solutions
* Creating robust tools for debugging, profiling, and optimizing network performance
* Educating team members on best practices for using shared networking technologies, empowering them to leverage their full potential


**Who You Are**
* Deep understanding of modern C++ within the context of Unreal Engine, including memory management, macros, and coding standards
* Proven experience with Unreal Engine’s replication system, actor lifecycle in a networked environment, and implementing RPCs
* 3+ years of experience in multiplayer programming, with at least one shipped title
* Experience working with platform-specific online subsystems such as Steam, PSN, and Xbox Live
* Experience with packet profiling, bandwidth optimization, and managing network relevance and culling in large-scale environments
* Strong coordination skills for cross-disciplinary collaboration and fluency in English
* Experience with the Gameplay Ability System (GAS) and its built-in networking capabilities
* Experience extending or overriding the UNetDriver or implementing custom DataBunch serialization
* Experience with dedicated server orchestration (Agones, AWS GameLift) or Matchmaking services
* Experience with networked physics and client-side prediction/reconciliation
* Comfortable working in an Agile/Scrum environment


 Note: Research shows under-represented groups in the industry might not apply to a job if they don’t check off every requirement. At Avalanche, we’re more about your drive to learn and interest in tackling challenges than what’s on your resume! So don’t stress if you don’t tick every box— shoot us your application anyway! Diverse opinions and different experiences are what make our teams so great, not itemized lists of qualifications.
   

  

**The Stockholm location**
 Our Stockholm office is situated in Södermalm, the beating heart of the city’s game industry. It’s a physical representation of our games – the lush vegetation of Just Cause and theHunter: Call of the Wild meets corroded metal straight out of Mad Max. Our hybrid model requires you to be in the office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays to foster collaboration and creativity.
   

  

**Our values**
 At Avalanche Studios Group, we create worlds beyond limits. But that’s not exclusive to our games, so we’re committed to developing a diverse and inclusive workplace. All Avalanchers have a shared responsibility to create an open work environment where everyone is treated equally and respectfully. Being part of our world is not contingent on your heritage, your gender, or sexual orientation. It’s all about your passion and creativity.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 To apply for this position, please register below and provide your CV in English. We review applications continuously. All further studio-related information is provided under a non-disclosure agreement.
   

  

 At Avalanche Studios Group we're always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our passionate team, but please note that relocation assistance is not available for this role.

title: Fullstack Engineer, Cloud & App Hosting
description:
**Why Lovable**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**About The Lovable Apps Platform**
 The Lovable Apps Platform is what makes those generated apps actually run in production. The moment a user hits deploy, the Apps Platform takes over — provisioning the database, handling user auth, storing files, serving the app over a custom domain, capturing logs, and metering usage. It's the full backend and hosting layer for every app built on Lovable, designed so creators never have to think about infrastructure to ship something real.
   

  

 The Lovable Apps Platform is what makes those generated apps actually run in production. The moment a user hits deploy, the Apps Platform takes over — provisioning the database, handling user auth, storing files, serving the app over a custom domain, capturing logs, and metering usage. It's the full backend and hosting layer for every app built on Lovable, designed so creators never have to think about infrastructure to ship something real.
   

  

 The Apps Platform is growing fast, and we're investing heavily in each layer of the stack — building deeper ownership over the services that power our users' apps so we can move faster, scale better, and shape the product experience us and our users actually want.
   

  

**The Role**
 We're looking for product-minded fullstack engineers who can own end-to-end slices of our Lovable Apps Platform. You'll build the interfaces, APIs, and integrations that let Lovable users manage their cloud resources — from admin panels and analytics dashboards to vendor abstraction layers and the AI gateway. This is the highest-surface-area layer of the stack: identity, logging, metering, workflow engine, buckets, database connection strings, secrets, custom domains, and connectors.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Create UX for our users to build with Apps Platform features
* Build and own platform services like identity, logging, metering, workflow engine, object storage, secrets
* Create abstraction layers for deep integrations with key partners and vendors


**What We're Looking For**
* Strong fullstack background: deep comfort with TypeScript/React on the frontend and Node.js or similar on the backend
* Experience building and operating SaaS platform features — auth flows, metering/billing pipelines, API gateways, or developer tooling
* Product instinct: you think in user outcomes, not just API endpoints
* Comfort working with third-party services and building clean abstractions over vendor APIs Familiarity with managed cloud services (AWS, GCP) and the tradeoffs of buy-vs-build
* Experience with observability, logging, or metering systems is a strong plus
* You've shipped features in fast-moving, high-ownership environments where you wore multiple hats
* Experience with DNS, TLS/SSL automation, and custom domain provisioning at scale


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with BaaS or PaaS platforms (Supabase, Firebase, Vercel, Render, etc.)
* Familiarity with TanStack Router/Query or similar modern frontend stacks
* Background in developer experience or developer tools
* Interest in AI-assisted development and how cloud infrastructure enables it


**Our tech stack**
 We're building with tools that both humans and AI love. Lovable software engineers are capable of working across the whole stack. Examples of tech in our stack include:
   

  

* Frontend: React and Typescript.
* Backend: Golang and Rust.
* Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS
* Data: Clickhouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery.
* DevOps & Tooling: CI/CD pipelines, OTEL, Kubernetes, Terraform.


 And always on the lookout for what's next!

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Most enterprise AI dies in the proof of concept. Forward deployed engineering is how we avoid that: you sit inside the customer's workflow — on site, in the bid room, in the procurement process — and build until the work actually gets done differently.
   

  

 This is not consulting and it is not a demo role. You ship product. You take a real bottleneck at a real contractor, build the agent workflow that removes it, prove the outcome in numbers, and bring what you learned back into the core platform.
   

  

 You are the shortest path from a customer problem to working software — and the reason our agents survive contact with the real world.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own named accounts end to end: understand the workflow, configure and extend our agents against their real documents and data, and get them into daily use
* Write code — integrations, data pipelines, prompts, evals, glue, and occasionally a whole new feature, whatever it takes to make the workflow work at that customer
* Define what success means before you start, then prove it: hours saved, bids won, risks caught
* Turn what only shows up in production into roadmap — patterns, failure modes and reusable building blocks that make the next deployment faster than the last


**You might be a fit if**
* You have several years building and shipping software — Python and/or TypeScript, APIs, data pipelines, databases and SQL
* You're comfortable with LLMs and modern AI tooling; we operate as an AI-first company
* You've worked directly with customers, or you have a clear appetite for it
* You go to where the work happens — site visits, bid rooms, warehouses — instead of guessing from a backlog
* You write clearly. At Brickanta, writing creates clarity and everything important gets documented
* You're pragmatic about craft: you know when to hack and when to build it properly
* You're comfortable with ambiguity, and with being the only engineer in the room
* You speak Swedish and English


 Construction, real estate or industrial experience is a strong plus. We're looking for engineers who like customers, and customer-facing people who actually ship — the unusual profile matters more than the perfect CV.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like**
* Deployments reach daily use instead of stalling after the pilot
* Every customer engagement ends with a number attached to it
* The second deployment is faster than the first, because you turned the first into building blocks
* The product roadmap reflects what's actually breaking in the field


 This seat sits close to everything — product, AI engineering and the customer. It can grow toward leading deployments and a team of FDEs, or inward toward core AI and platform engineering, depending on where you become most effective.
   

  

**The practical details**
 Mid to senior; we care more about what you've built than about years. On-site as default at Linnégatan 89B, Stockholm, with meaningful time at customers. Competitive salary and equity — you're early enough for it to matter. Start as soon as you can.
   

  

**Process**
 Intro call, 15–20 minutes. A practical case — a short task or working session that reflects the actual job. Then come to the office and meet the team. Fast process, quick feedback at every stage.
   

  

 Keen on doing your life's work — bringing one of the world's largest and most impactful industries, the $15 trillion construction industry, into the AI era? Send us an email at carrers@brickanta.com or apply directly at https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/brickanta/jobs/2fZBSaD-forward-deployed-engineer.
   

  

**About Brickanta**
 Brickanta (Brickanta.com) is the AI-native agentic platform for construction bid analysis, cost estimation and procurement. Brickanta's industry know-how AI raises margins and saves time by leveraging historical estimates, tender documents, and project data — so builders can focus on building. The founding team has been building with AI since 2018 and brings deep experience applying AI in construction and industrial sectors. Brickanta has raised over $8M in external funding from leading investors, including Northzone, Anton Osika and Mario Götze.

title: Developer Intern — Summer 2027
description:

* Integration work — APIs, third-party tools, data pipelines
* Documentation and technical write-ups

* You're studying or recently graduated in computer science, software engineering or similar — or you have equivalent experience through projects, self-study or work
* You're proficient in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript
* You're familiar with RESTful APIs, data pipelines and systems integration
* You have working knowledge of databases and SQL
* You're comfortable with Git and modern development workflows
* You're comfortable with AI tooling like Claude Code and Codex — we operate as an AI-first company
* You have a builder mentality: you take ownership, move fast and care about craft
* You write clearly. At Brickanta, writing creates clarity and everything important gets documented
* You work transparently — you share context, flag blockers early, and contribute to a shared source of truth
* You're curious and hungry to learn, and you push to understand how and why things work


 Familiarity with Docker or Kubernetes is a bonus, not a requirement. Background or hands-on experience in construction is a strong plus for at least one of the positions.
   

  

 We care more about what you've built than where you studied.
   

  

**How We Evaluate**
* Show us what you've built — repos, demos, side projects, shipped products
* Product sense: can you reason from user pain to solution to measurable outcome
* You move fast and care about craft
* You communicate clearly and write things down


**The practical details**
 On-site in Stockholm at Linnégatan 89B. Compensation is equivalent to a full CSN stipend, so you can focus fully on the internship. Perks include the office, snacks and team summer events.
   

  

 Work period starts May/June 2027, with the option to begin part-time earlier if you're keen and your schedule allows. Full-time through the summer, finishing in August. High performers may be offered an ongoing full-time or part-time role afterwards.

 Intro call, 15–20 minutes. A short home assignment that reflects the kind of work you'd be doing. Then come to the office, see how we work and meet the people you'd be building with. An offer letter follows once all steps are complete. Quick feedback at every stage — we don't let candidates wait.
   

  

 Keen on doing your life's work — bringing one of the world's largest and most impactful industries, the $15 trillion construction industry, into the AI era? Send us an email at careers (a) brickanta.com or apply directly at https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/brickanta/jobs/XmiJoZB-developer-intern-summer-2027 .

 Brickanta (Brickanta.com) is the AI-native agentic platform for construction bid analysis, cost estimation and procurement. The founding team has been building with AI since 2018 and brings deep experience applying AI in construction and industrial sectors. Brickanta has raised over $8M in external funding from leading investors, including Northzone, Anton Osika and Mario Götze.

title: Construction Evaluation Engineer (Part-Time)
description:
Construction doesn't buy "AI". It buys answers it can act on — and an answer can look completely plausible while being wrong in the way that costs money on a real project. The Construction Evaluation Engineer role exists to catch exactly that: to define what great looks like for our agents, find where they fail, and turn that judgment into something our systems can measure.
   

  

 It starts hands-on and close to the data, and gets more technical as you grow — from evaluating outputs to owning eval pipelines, graders and datasets. You'll work alongside our forward deployed engineers, design partners and construction experts. Evaluation here happens close to the customer, not in a disconnected labeling operation.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Run our agents against real construction workflows and judge the outputs on correctness, completeness and practical usefulness — not on whether they sound convincing
* Turn real workflows, edge cases and production failures into repeatable eval cases: reference outputs, scoring rubrics, failure taxonomies and expert-reviewed datasets
* Grow into the systems around the work — eval harnesses, automated graders, regression tests, model comparisons
* Work out what genuinely needs human judgment, then engineer the rest away
* Capture what we learn from customers, experts and agent failures so every deployment improves the underlying system


**You might be a fit if**
* You have real exposure to construction, engineering, project planning, estimating or surveying
* You're strongly quantitative and analytical, with a serious interest in modern AI systems
* You're extremely detail-oriented — you can work through hundreds of cases without letting the quality bar drift
* You're curious about why systems fail, not just whether they fail
* You have an instinct for automation: understand the manual workflow first, then build the system around it
* You have high ownership — you find the issue, understand it, and close the loop
* You speak Swedish and English


 You don't need to already be an experienced AI engineer. You need the raw ingredients to become one.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like**
* We know where our agents are weak before a customer finds out
* "Good output" stops being a matter of opinion and becomes something we measure
* Failures turn into eval cases instead of recurring surprises
* You grow into a larger technical seat — Evaluation Engineering, Applied AI, Forward Deployed Engineering or AI/Data Engineering. This isn't a permanent part-time labeling role; the long-term role gets built around you


**The practical details**
 Part-time to start, roughly 15–20 hours per week, flexible on how they're distributed. Hybrid with meaningful time at the office at Linnégatan 89B, Stockholm. Paid hourly, growing with the company in responsibility, compensation, ownership and equity.
   

  

**Process**
 Intro call, 15–20 minutes. A short home assignment that reflects the actual work. Then come to the office and meet the team. Fast process, quick feedback at every stage.
   

  

 Keen on doing your life's work — bringing one of the world's largest and most impactful industries, the $15 trillion construction industry, into the AI era? Send us an email at careers@ brickanta.com or apply directly at https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/brickanta/jobs/KfaKQd2-construction-evaluation-engineer-part-time.
   

  

**About Brickanta**
 Brickanta (Brickanta.com) is the AI-native agentic platform for construction bid analysis, cost estimation and procurement. Brickanta's industry know-how AI raises margins and saves time by leveraging historical estimates, tender documents, and project data — so builders can focus on building. The founding team has been building with AI since 2018 and brings deep experience applying AI in construction and industrial sectors. Brickanta has raised over $8M in external funding from leading investors, including Northzone, Anton Osika and Mario Götze.

* Arbeta i uppdrag som är affärskritiska och tekniskt utmanande

* Möjlighet att påverka både uppdrag och din egen utveckling

title: SAP Solution Architect Security
description:
**Job Description**
 At Billerud we believe that when we have tomorrow in mind, we will do our very best today. It is thanks to our employees that we are a world-leading company within the field of renewable paper and packaging materials. Do you want to realize your true value and work for a sustainable tomorrow? Join us!
   

  

  

  

 Are you passionate about SAP security, identity management, and building secure solutions that enable business transformation? A unique opportunity to shape and develop Billerud’s future global SAP landscape in a true greenfield transformation.
   

  

  

  

 As part of Billerud's SAP S/4HANA journey, we are looking for a SAP Solution Architect Security to take overall responsibility for SAP security architecture, authorization concepts, and Identity & Access Governance across our SAP landscape.
   

  

  

  

**About The Role**
 As SAP Solution Architect Security, you will be responsible for shaping and governing SAP security and access management across Billerud's SAP ecosystem. Working closely with business stakeholders, project teams, security specialists, and external partners, you will ensure that authorization models, identity integrations, and governance processes support both business requirements and compliance standards.
   

  

  

  

 The role combines strategic architecture responsibilities with hands-on expertise in SAP security, access governance, and identity management, making it ideal for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of business, technology, and risk management.
   

  

  

  

**Your Main Tasks Will Be**
* Define and maintain SAP security architecture, authorization concepts, and access governance processes across SAP platforms.
* Design and optimize roles, authorizations, and identity integrations for SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, and related solutions.
* Ensure compliance with Segregation of Duties (SoD), internal controls, and regulatory requirements.


  

  

* Support identity and access governance processes, including role lifecycle management, risk analysis, and access provisioning.


  

  

* Collaborate with business stakeholders, project teams, auditors, and external partners to secure compliant and scalable solutions.


  

  

* Support SAP transformation initiatives by embedding security-by-design principles in projects, upgrades, and rollouts.


  

  

* Drive continuous improvements within SAP security, governance, and identity management practices.


  

  

**You report to:** 
 Manager Global SAP Applications.
   

  

 While the preferred location for this role is Solna, the position can also be based in one of our mills in Sweden. Frequent travel to our Solna office is an essential part of the role.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* University degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field.


  

  

* Documented experience working with SAP Security and Authorizations.


  

  

* Deep understanding of SAP authorization concepts, role design, and access governance.


  

  

* Experience supporting audits, compliance activities, and regulatory requirements.


  

  

* Good understanding of Segregation of Duties (SoD), risk management, and internal controls.


  

  

  

  

* Experience with SAP Identity Access Governance (IAG), SAP GRC, or similar governance tools is considered highly beneficial.


  

  

* Knowledge of identity integrations involving SAP solutions, Azure AD, IAS/IPS, or enterprise IAM platforms.


  

  

* Understanding of SAP licensing principles and how role design impacts license allocation is an advantage.


  

  

* SAP Security or SAP GRC certifications are considered beneficial.


  

  

* Fluency in English, both written and spoken.


  

  

 Note: You need to have a permanent Swedish work permit to be considered for this position
   

  

**Personal qualities**
 You are an analytical and detail-oriented professional with a strong interest in security, governance, and risk management. You enjoy solving complex challenges and balancing security requirements with business needs.
   

  

 You collaborate effectively across organizational boundaries and communicate confidently with both technical specialists and business stakeholders. With a structured and proactive approach, you build trust, drive improvements, and contribute to sustainable and compliant solutions.
   

  

 As a team player, you thrive in an international environment and are committed to delivering high-quality results that support both operational excellence and long-term business goals.
   

  

 Our values are central to our business, and we believe you recognize yourself in: We care for each other and We do what we say!
   

  

**Contact**
 If you have any questions, don't hesitate to reach out to Katarina Kopkin, Senior Manager Global Applications; katarina.kopkin@billerud.com or if you have any questions regarding the recruitment, please contact Mimmi Jonsson, Sr TAP; mimmi.jonsson@billerud.com
   

  

**Application information**
 Selection and interviews will be held on an ongoing basis. Please apply as soon as possible.
   

  

**Do you want to help create a sustainable future through your work?**
 At Billerud, we are fully committed to reduce our and our customers carbon footprint by offering high-performance paper and packaging materials. We are convinced that the right solutions can be important tools to help fight climate change. That's why we see it as our responsibility to enable the best packaging choices, for a better tomorrow.
   

  

 Our proud history in the forestry and paper industry goes back more than 150 years. Since then, we’ve grown to what we are today: a world leading company in high-performing paper and packaging materials - passionately committed to sustainability, quality, and customer value. Our materials are the basis of packaging and paper products used by millions of people around the world, 24 hours a day, all year round.
   

  

 We serve customers in more than 100 countries through our three business areas Liquid Packaging Board, Paper and Paper Board. Our nine production units are located in Sweden, USA, and Finland and we have around 5,200 employees in 16 countries. Our annual turnover is approximately SEK 40.5 billion and the share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. At Billerud we always put safety first, care for each other, and do what we say.
   

  

 Join us in redefining sustainable packaging and drive meaningful change for a better tomorrow.

 Är du serviceinriktad, kommunikativ och vill arbeta med att hjälpa kunder via telefon och digitala lösningar i ett hälsobolag?
   

  

 Har du förmågan - att som del av vårt team - både lära nytt och bidra till att vi utvecklas tillsammans?

 Då är det kanske just dig vi söker!

title: Underhållsledare Stationsunderhåll Stockholm - Vattenfall Eldistribution
description:
Vill du ha ett meningsfullt jobb där du får bidra till att göra verklig skillnad både för samhället och energiomställningen? Hos oss är du en del av en samhällsviktig verksamhet med spännande projekt, teknik i framkant och kollegor som värdesätter varandra.
   

  

**Nu söker vi en erfaren Underhållsledare som vill vara med och bygga upp framtidens underhållsverksamhet!**
 Vi står inför en av Vattenfall Eldistributions största satsningar någonsin – en historisk kraftsamling för att bygga en starkare, mer motståndskraftig och helt egen förmåga inom underhåll, felsökning och reparation. I en tid när omvärlden ställer allt högre krav på robusthet och uthållighet tar vi avgörande steg för att säkra ett elnät som klarar svåra förhållanden och levererar när det behövs som mest.
   

  

**Din roll som Underhållsledare**
 Stationsavdelningen arbetar inom spänningsintervallet 0,4–400 kV och ansvarar för underhåll, projekt samt felsökning i ställverk, kontrollanläggningar och annan elkraftsutrustning. Som Underhållsledare får du en viktig roll i att både driva mindre projekt och ombyggnationer samt planera och samordna underhåll och service i våra egna anläggningar.
   

  

 Vi söker dig som motiveras av att skapa de bästa förutsättningarna för tekniker och ingenjörer ute i fält, och för verksamheten som helhet. Rollen innebär stort fokus på säkerhet, kvalitet, framdrift och engagemang. Säkerheten är ledstjärnan i allt vi gör, i en riskfylld miljö tar vi hand om varandra och skapar trygghet tillsammans.
   

  

**Exempel på arbetsuppgifter**
* Planera, prioritera och följa upp underhållsåtgärder utifrån tekniska och ekonomiska förutsättningar.
* Leda och fördela arbetet i fält och säkerställa att uppdrag genomförs tryggt, effektivt och enligt gällande krav.
* Analysera tekniska underlag som protokoll, besiktningar och anläggningsdata samt initiera rätt åtgärder.
* Säkerställa kvalitet och säkerhet genom kontroller i fält, safety walks och uppföljning av arbetsmiljö- och säkerhetsrutiner.
* Samverka nära driftcentral, tekniker, entreprenörer och interna funktioner för att optimera planering och framdrift.
* Ta rollen som Bas-P och utse Bas-U vid bygg‑ och anläggningsarbeten och vid behov upprätta arbetsmiljöplan.
* Arbeta enligt företagets egenkontrollprogram för elinstallationer och säkerställa rätt kompetens och roller i uppdraget.
* Utse elsäkerhetsledare och fastställa metodval enligt ESA tillsammans med denne.
* Bidra till teknisk utveckling genom att delta i olika förbättrings- och utvecklingsprojekt.


 Arbetet bedrivs till stor del från kontoret men en viktig del av uppdraget är att vara närvarande i våra anläggningar och värna om dem genom ett långsiktigt, kvalitativt och omsorgsfullt underhåll. Dagsresor är därmed en naturlig del av rollen.
   

  

 Kvalifikationer
   

  

 Som Underhållsledare inom vår egen underhållsverksamhet är du teknikergruppens viktigaste stöd i det dagliga arbetet ute i elnätet. Ledarskap är en central del av rollen, därför söker vi dig som har ett coachande, lösningsorienterat och kommunikativt arbetssätt.
   

  

 I rollen ingår att ta ansvar för planering, prioritering och genomförande av underhållsarbete i vårt elnät och du har alltid säkerheten som högsta prioritet. Du driver arbetet framåt på ett organiserat och engagerat sätt, med fokus på hög leveranskvalitet och god service gentemot kollegor, kunder och andra intressenter.
   

  

* Gymnasial utbildning eller högre, gärna inom el, elkraft, teknik eller annat relevant område
* Arbetslivserfarenhet inom eldistribution eller annat närliggande arbetsområde
* God datorvana, inklusive Office-paketet
* B-körkort
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift


 Meriterande för tjänsten är erfarenhet av projekt- eller serviceledning inom stationsunderhåll. Även erfarenhet av arbete i ärendehanteringssystem eller av att arbeta i affärssystemet SAP.
   

  

 Ytterligare information
   

  

**Vi erbjuder** 
 en spännande arbetsvardag och en bra balans i livet på en attraktiv arbetsplats med goda möjligheter till utveckling. Vi arbetar i en säker och motiverande arbetsmiljö, med en stark och positiv kultur präglad av omtanke för alla. För att du ska trivas erbjuder vi möjlighet till ständigt lärande, bra arbetsvillkor och ett brett utbud av personalförmåner - Läs mer om våra förmåner här.
   

  

**Placeringsort** 
  

  

 Södra Stockholm t.ex. Södertälje eller Skogås
   

  

**För mer information** 
 om tjänsten kontakta rekryterande chef Conny Hurtig, conny.hurtig@vattenfall.com.
   

  

 För frågor om rekryteringsprocessen, kontakta rekryterare Johanna Sperling, johanna.sperling@vattenfall.com.
   

  

 Fackliga representanter för denna tjänst är Christian Ericsson, Ledarna, Anne-Marie Sjöbohm, Akademikerna, Jan-Olof Eriksson, Unionen, Ulf Tengman, SEKO. Alla kontaktpersoner nås via Vattenfalls växel 08-739 50 00.
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 6 september 2026!** 

 Vi tar inte emot personligt brev i ansökan. Du söker snabbt och enkelt genom att svara på urvalsfrågor och bifoga ditt CV. Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vår webbplats. I den här rekryteringsprocessen kommer tester att förekomma. Urval och intervjuer sker efter sista ansökningsdag.

En eventuell krigsplacering sker med stöd i anställningsavtalet och lagen om totalförsvarsplikt.
   

  

 På Vattenfall värdesätter vi att vara aktiva, positiva, öppna och säkerhetsmedvetna. Vi söker medarbetare som delar vår vision och kan bidra till att stärka vår företagskultur. Vi är övertygade om att mångfald bidrar till att bygga ett mer lönsamt och tilltalande företag och strävar efter att vara goda förebilder när det gäller mångfald. title: Principal Designer
description:
**We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!**
*As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together.*
**The Role**
 We’re looking for a seasoned and highly capable Product Designer that has experience in elevating design impact across a wide range of products, in a complex space. In this role, you will work closely with key stakeholders and product designers to maximize the quality of the user experience in several realms.
   

  

 We’re in a phase of continuous and intense iteration, refinement and reshaping of several parts of our product offering. Our ambitions are high – we want to have a world-class portfolio of products that effectively meet our users needs and have a strong and positive impact on their day to day lives. The person in this role will play an integral part in achieving this.
   

  

 You will be working out of a centralized design team, together with design leadership, UX Research, Writing and Localization, supporting initiatives across several product verticals and ecosystems (including apps, web, wearables, automotive, as well as hardware). In your day to day, you will spend a lot of time with the full, 30 person strong, design team. You will be reporting to the Head of Product Design.
   

  

 The broader R&D organization includes a genuinely diverse and distributed team of over 450 talented specialists in product, engineering, design, and analytics.
   

  

**How To Make An Impact**
* Having a strong focus on collaboration and enablement, with an entrepreneurial mindset. Roll up your sleeves and partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders and peers, to elevate execution and impact across the product offering.
* Drive or support ambitious, ambiguous and strategically important projects from a design standpoint. Cover work spanning across teams and domains to ensure consistency, quality and impact.
* Support in shaping the longer term direction for the suite of products. Work to define both visual directionality and strategic momentum. Uncover and support in capitalizing on new, undiscovered opportunities.
* Ensure a high bar of quality and consistency across products. Support and mentor junior and senior designers, developing craft, enabling best practices, and strengthening design culture. Take a systemic approach and ensure processes are clear and efficient.


**About You**
 You are a well experienced product designer with a strong track record of shipping impactful work. You’ve likely spent plenty of time at product companies – either larger ones, or startups – working in cross-functional contexts, but agency side experience is also of relevance.
   

  

 You have a world-class foundation in craft, allowing you to execute quickly with an outstanding bar of quality. You also hold an ability to quickly grasp strategic perspectives. Your experience and skillset means that you can navigate ambiguity with ease and are comfortable tackling nuanced challenges with senior stakeholders, as well as more junior collaborators.
   

  

 You’re equally comfortable with taking on initiatives to improve processes, or coach more junior designers, as you are with creating high fidelity prototypes, weaving complex functionality into elegant interfaces with ease.
   

  

**Your background**
* 10+ years of experience in design, with an emphasis on product design work in cross functional contexts.
* Demonstrated experience from working with ambiguous challenges, collaborating with senior stakeholders.
* Proven experience in leading high stakes product design work, including early stage discovery phases, with examples of contributions on successful products.
* World-class craftsmanship – creating high quality design work is second nature, and something you do very quickly. Rapid, high fidelity, prototyping is a given for you.
* 2+ years of experience in people management, mentoring or coaching.


 This role is a hybrid working role and can be based in our offices located across Stockholm, London, Łódź, or Atlanta - 3 days in the office per week, 2 from home.
   

  

**About Arrive**
 Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable: from smart payments and optimized car parks to data-driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.

title: Product Manager (Identity & Access Management)
description:
**TL;DR:** 
 We’re looking for a Product Manager to help shape Lovable’s Identity & Access Management team and own how authentication, authorization, and identity work across the existing Lovable app ecosystem and the more than one million new apps built every week. You’ll work with a talented team of engineers and designers to build open, scalable identity primitives that serve individual builders, enterprises, application users, developers, and AI agents without compromising Lovable’s simplicity.
   

  

 Why Lovable?
   

  

 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

 What we’re looking for
   

  

* Significant experience owning technically complex products, across identity, authentication, authorization, developer platforms, or infrastructure.
* A track record of setting product direction in ambiguous problem spaces, aligning teams around a clear strategy, and turning that strategy into shipped products.
* Strong knowledge of modern identity systems and open standards, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM, passkeys, service accounts, roles, permissions, and policy-based access control.
* Technical fluency. You program or have programmed, and can engage credibly with engineers on platform architecture, APIs, data models, security boundaries, and identity protocols.
* Strong product sense and systems thinking. You can prioritize across authentication, authorization, and identity needs while building simple primitives that can support enormous scale and increasingly sophisticated use cases.
* Exceptional communication skills and sharp judgment. You can navigate difficult tradeoffs, explain the options and consequences clearly, and help teams reach informed decisions.
* A deep appreciation for the needs of personal and enterprise users, as well as both sides of the Lovable experience: the builder configuring identity and the end user interacting with a Lovable-built app.


 What you’ll do
   

  

* Represent the user. Develop a deep understanding of identity needs across existing Lovable-built apps and the more than one million new apps created every week.
* Own the product strategy and roadmap for authentication, authorization, and identity, making deliberate tradeoffs between immediate user needs and durable platform foundations.
* Define standards-based primitives for users, organizations, agents, roles, permissions, policies, sessions, and delegated access that can scale across a vast and varied application ecosystem.
* Shape a smooth identity experience for both builders configuring their apps and the people using those apps.
* Partner closely with engineering to balance the needs of individual builders and enterprise organizations, preserving Lovable’s simplicity while building a foundation that can scale.
* Define how AI agents and other non-human identities authenticate, receive authority, act on behalf of users, and remain understandable and controllable.
* Own identity and access needs for programmatic use of Lovable across API, CLI, SDK, and MCP surfaces.
* Keep it simple. Ship the right slice of functionality, validate what works through user feedback and metrics, and cut what doesn’t.


 Projects you’ll tackle first: Partner with engineering to shape and deliver a multi-tenant identity service built on open standards that supports authentication and authorization across millions of applications and provides a durable foundation for Lovable.
   

  

**About Your Application**
 Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Product Manager – Survey & Design
description:
*10% of Europe’s CO₂ emissions are caused by residential heating and energy bills are out of control. Aira is here to change that.*
*With our intelligent Aira Heat Pump at the heart, we’re making the switch to clean energy-tech easier and more affordable. Helping Europe turn off gas and slashing energy costs one home at a time.*
*Founded in 2022, and with 1200+ employees and counting, Aira is driving the clean energy revolution by providing homes with modern clean energy-tech solutions such as solar power, battery storage solutions and heat pumps. With a state-of-the-art production facility in Poland, and HQ in Stockholm, Sweden, and hubs across the UK, Germany and Italy, Aira is well on track to install clean energy-tech into 5 million homes by 2034.*
***About the Survey & Design team:***
 The Survey & Design team is part of the Acquisition Area of Aira, which is responsible for the entire sales journey, from lead generation to installed heat pump. Our team sits right in the middle of this, with a critical mission:
   

  

 Build tools that help Aira qualify, size, and design the right energy solution for every home — tools that get more accurate with every installation we do.
   

  

 When selling a heat pump system, you need to know what size of heat pump should be installed and whether any radiators need replacing. If we over-estimate this number, the customer will be paying more than they have to. If we under-estimate this number, we could install a heat pump that is unable to heat our customers' homes. Getting it right is crucial for both conversion and fast, efficient installations. And Aira is uniquely positioned to solve this: we own the entire feedback loop, from qualification through to monitoring the installed heat pump.
   

  

***About the role:***
 Your main stakeholders are our Design Engineers, who work in customers' homes, but our tools impact almost every role in the Aira sales funnel, from Qualification, Sales, and Design all the way to Procurement, Planning, and Installation. You'll own the product direction for these tools across all our markets (UK, Germany, and Italy), offices (Stockholm and Helsingborg), and the factory (Poland).
   

  

 You'll lead a cross-functional team of software engineers and a designer, with a high degree of autonomy.
   

  

***Key responsibilities:***
* Lead a cross-functional team of software engineers and a product designer, setting priorities and deciding what to build, when, and why.
* Own the product strategy and roadmap for Aira's survey, heat loss, and design tooling, ensuring alignment with the Acquisition Area's goal of profitable, high-quality installations.
* Drive the team's long-term differentiator: an accuracy-and-learning loop that uses installation telemetry to measure and reduce heat loss estimation error at every stage of the funnel.
* Become the domain expert on heat loss calculations, balancing each market's regulatory requirements against Aira's business goals.
* Act as the bridge between deep technical work and the field reality of a Design Engineer working on an iPad in a customer's home.
* Drive the roll-out of our tools across all markets and make sure they're adopted across every user group.
* Define the metrics and track how we're progressing toward our goals.


***We expect you to have:***
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Engineering, Business, or a related discipline).
* 3 years of experience in a similar Product Manager role, leading cross-functional teams of engineers and designers.
* The ability to own a technically and domain-complex product. You don't need to be a heating engineer, but you must be comfortable diving into a quantitative, calculation-driven domain and earning the trust of expert users.
* Strong data and analytics instincts: defining the right metrics, designing measurement (and recognising when a metric is misleading), and using data to drive decisions.


***It would be a bonus if you:***
* Have studied thermodynamics.
* Are a homeowner, as it helps you understand the challenges our users face every day.
* Have experience building tools for field-based, operational, or expert workforces.
* Can speak German or Italian.


**What is in it for you?**
* Gain hands-on experience in a fast-growing scale-up, with a supportive and inclusive culture, and career advancement opportunities.
* Collaborate with diverse teams across international markets and launch products globally.
* Develop and grow personally and professionally in an entrepreneurial-minded environment.
* Thrive in a dynamic, solution-oriented culture, tackling challenges and driving meaningful solutions that make a positive impact on the world.
* Influence the company's success, with a visible impact on product development and market growth.
* Enjoy our brand-new office at Norra Stationsgatan 93 in Stockholm. Conveniently located near public transport, with Sankt Eriksplan and Odenplan stations just a few minutes walk away.


 At Aira, we champion next-generation energy as well as diversity and inclusion. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce fosters innovation and creativity, enhancing our ability to serve customers and communities effectively. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, cultures and perspectives to join our team. Our commitment is to uphold equality and inclusivity, fostering a collaborative environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to a better future for our people and the planet.

 På Lantmännen genomför vi en omfattande utveckling av våra produktionsanläggningar där digitalisering, standardisering och cybersäkerhet står högt på agendan. För att möta framtida krav, inklusive NIS2 och ökade krav på robusta OT-miljöer, söker vi nu en OT Specialist.
   

  

**Det här kommer du att göra**
 Som OT Specialist får du en central roll i arbetet med att utveckla, standardisera och säkra våra produktionsnära IT- och OT-miljöer. Du arbetar nära våra foderfabriker, spannmålsmottagningar, utsädesanläggningar och växtförädlingsstationer runt om i Sverige och blir en viktig länk mellan produktion, IT, cybersäkerhetsfunktioner och externa leverantörer.
   

  

 Rollen kombinerar operativt ansvar med långsiktig utveckling. Du bidrar både till att säkerställa en stabil drift idag och till att bygga framtidens OT-miljöer genom förbättrade arbetssätt, tekniska standarder och säkerhetsstrukturer.
   

  

 Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden omfattar att:
   

  

* Säkerställa stabil drift, support och livscykelhantering av produktionsnära IT- och OT-lösningar.
* Driva förbättringsinitiativ inom standardisering, digitalisering och teknisk utveckling av våra anläggningar.
* Bidra till utvecklingen av säkra OT-miljöer i linje med interna säkerhetskrav och externa regelverk såsom NIS2.
* Delta i inventering, klassificering och riskbedömning av OT-tillgångar och kritiska system.
* Agera teknisk kravställare vid upphandling och införande av nya lösningar.
* Samarbeta med verksamhet, IT, cybersäkerhetsspecialister och leverantörer för att säkerställa robusta och framtidssäkra lösningar.
* Bidra till utvecklingen av gemensamma arbetssätt, tekniska standarder och governance för OT inom Lantmännen.


**Det här behöver du för att lyckas**
 Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av industriella miljöer och som trivs i en roll där teknik, produktion och säkerhet möts.
   

  

**Du har**
* Erfarenhet av OT, industriell IT eller produktionsnära IT i tillverkande eller processnära verksamhet.
* God förståelse för industriella nätverk, servrar, klientmiljöer och verksamhetskritiska produktionssystem.
* Erfarenhet av teknisk kravställning, leverantörsstyrning och genomförande av tekniska förbättringsinitiativ.

* Relevant utbildning inom IT, OT, automation eller motsvarande erfarenhet.
* B-körkort och möjlighet att resa regelbundet till våra anläggningar i Sverige.

* Självständig och ansvarstagande samtidigt som du trivs med att samarbeta med andra.

* Nyfiken, utvecklingsdriven och engagerad i ny teknik, digitalisering och cybersäkerhet.

 Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med teknik som är avgörande för en samhällsviktig verksamhet. Du blir en del av en organisation som investerar långsiktigt i digitalisering, cybersäkerhet och moderna produktionsmiljöer.

* Arbete nära verksamheten där resultaten av ditt arbete syns direkt i produktionen.
* En bred och varierad roll med stora kontaktytor inom produktion, IT och cybersäkerhet.

Technology and digitalisation play an increasingly important role in how we develop both our operations and our offering. We deliver smart logistics solutions to everyone from mid-sized Nordic companies to world-leading international enterprises.***
*We now want to take the next step and strengthen our ability to harness technology and digitalisation — to develop our customer offering and, at the same time, run our operations more efficiently. We are therefore introducing the role of VP Technology & Digitalisation in the group management team, with a clear group-wide mandate and direct reporting to the CEO.*
**About the role:**
 As VP Technology & Digitalisation, you take on a key role in Logent's continued growth and transformation. The role combines technology, digitalisation and transformation with a clear business and customer perspective. Technology, data, AI, security and digitalisation are to be an integral part of how we develop customer value, efficiency, scalability and new services. Your assignment is to set the group-wide direction for Technology & Digitalisation and, together with the business and the Group's technology and IT function, develop a modern, scalable and business-oriented technology platform where systems, data, integrations and AI together strengthen our operational capability, customer offering and competitiveness.
   

  

 An essential initial priority is to harmonise a systems landscape built during a period of strong growth for Logent, both organic and through acquisitions. You identify the weaknesses, evaluate together with the relevant business areas what is scalable, and introduce the right technology in the right place with a cost-efficient and pragmatic mindset. At the same time, you establish a clear architecture for how our systems, integrations and data should work together — with the right balance between group-wide standardisation and customer-specific flexibility.
   

  

 You also create a modern, scalable environment where AI becomes a natural part of how we drive long-term efficiency in flows, planning and administration, without compromising security. You develop Logent's capabilities within data and AI and translate them into concrete business and customer value.
   

  

 Technology and digitalisation are an important part of Logent's customer offering. You work closely with our business areas and key customers — from pre-sales and solution design to implementation and further development — to ensure that technology, data and digitalisation strengthen our customer solutions and long-term competitiveness.
   

  

 You lead the group-wide Technology & Digitalisation agenda and work closely with the Group's technology and IT function as well as business-oriented digital resources in the business areas. Together, you develop Logent's overall capability and drive a transformation journey that touches the entire company.
   

  

 The mandate is broad, and you drive the group-wide strategic agenda with responsibility for direction and principles across architecture, data, integrations, resilience, cyber and information security, standards and strategic technology partners. You develop and manage an effective partner and supplier portfolio and create a scalable technology and integration model that supports Logent's continued organic growth as well as future acquisitions. You lead through close collaboration with the business areas, where business-critical solution decisions are made close to operations and the customer.
   

  

**Who are you?**
* Which industry you come from matters less to us — what matters more is the experience and knowledge you bring. You are a modern technology leader with high energy and marked pragmatism, with strong people sense and the ability to make people listen and act.
* You have experience of developing and simplifying complex systems landscapes and of driving technology change in an operationally close environment. You understand how architecture, data, integrations, AI and information security together create scalability, efficiency and business value.
* You are confident in dialogue with group management and the board as well as with key customers, and you express technology in business terms: cost, risk, customer promise and time.
* You work fluently in English.


 Experience from production-oriented and business-critical environments — WMS, TMS or other operational platforms — is an advantage, as is experience of taking data platforms and AI applications all the way into operations. Experience of strategic supplier and partner management, sourcing and portfolio management is also an advantage.
   

  

**Application:**
 Please submit your application together with your CV and a cover letter explaining why you are the right person for this role. If you have any questions about the position or the recruitment process, please contact Thérèse Grivérus at therese.griverus@logent.se.
   

  

 For GDPR reasons, we are unable to process applications submitted by email.
   

  

 We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Kravanalytiker – Digitaliseringsprojekt inom offentlig hälso- och sjukvård
description:
**Kravanalytiker – Digitaliseringsprojekt inom offentlig hälso- och sjukvård**
==============================================================================


Vi söker en **senior kravanalytiker** till ett uppdrag inom digitalisering i offentlig hälso- och sjukvård. Rollen passar dig som har gedigen erfarenhet av kvalificerat kravarbete i komplexa IT-miljöer och som är van att driva kravprocessen från tidig behovsanalys till implementering, verifiering och test.

**Om rollen**
-------------


Som kravanalytiker arbetar du på uppdrag av huvudprojektledare och/eller IT-projektledare och ansvarar för att planera, strukturera och leda kravarbetet genom projektets samtliga faser.


Du säkerställer att projektet har en komplett, kvalitetssäkrad och verifierbar kravbild samt att verksamhetsprocesser och arbetsflöden är tydligt definierade. Krav dokumenteras och hanteras i **Azure DevOps**.


Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med verksamhetsrepresentanter, projektledning, utvecklare, testare, upphandlingsledare och andra intressenter.


Beroende på projektens storlek och komplexitet kan du komma att arbeta parallellt i cirka **1–3 projekt**.

**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------


I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

* Planera, driva och koordinera kravarbete i digitaliseringsprojekt.
* Analysera verksamhetens behov och omvandla dessa till tydliga och verifierbara krav.
* Ta fram kravplaner, kravspecifikationer och övrig dokumentation enligt kundens kravprocess.
* Dokumentera både funktionella och icke-funktionella krav.
* Säkerställa spårbarhet, kvalitet och testbarhet i kravbilden.
* Kartlägga och dokumentera verksamhetsprocesser och arbetsflöden.
* Identifiera saknade eller otydliga behov och krav.
* Leda workshops och kravmöten med olika delar av verksamheten.
* Säkerställa att rätt kompetenser och resurser involveras i kravarbetet.
* Stötta och utbilda projektmedlemmar och verksamhetsrepresentanter i kravmetodik vid behov.
* Samarbeta med testledning för att uppnå hög testtäckning.
* Bidra i förstudier, analyser och utredningar.
* Stödja upphandlingsledare vid offentliga upphandlingar.
* Hantera och analysera frågeställningar från leverantörer.
* Medverka vid utvärdering av leverantörer och verifiera att uppställda krav är uppfyllda.
* Säkerställa att gällande IT-ramverk, regelverk och verksamhetskrav följs.

**Vi söker dig som**
--------------------


Du är en erfaren och självgående kravanalytiker som trivs i komplexa organisationer med många intressenter.


Du arbetar strukturerat och noggrant och har förmåga att både se helheten och hantera detaljer. Du är kommunikativ, prestigelös och lyhörd samtidigt som du är trygg i att leda arbetet framåt och utmana verksamheten när det behövs.


Du har ett starkt verksamhets- och användarfokus och är van att kommunicera med såväl verksamhetspersoner som tekniska specialister, utvecklare, projektledare och testare.

**Obligatoriska kvalifikationer**
---------------------------------


För uppdraget krävs:

* Minst **9–12 års dokumenterad erfarenhet som kravanalytiker**.
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av kravarbete kring **verksamhetsprocesser, beslutsstöd och AI inom offentligt styrd hälso- och sjukvård**.
* Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera, dokumentera och presentera på **svenska**, både muntligt och skriftligt.
* Praktisk erfarenhet av **Azure DevOps** för krav- och testhantering.
* Erfarenhet av **medicintekniska produkter och tillhörande regelverk**.
* Erfarenhet av **informationsklassning**.
* Erfarenhet av regionala processer vid införande av digitala lösningar.
* Erfarenhet av kravarbete inom **offentlig upphandling**.
* Erfarenhet av att driva **förstudier och utredningar inom offentlig organisation eller verksamhet**.
* Möjlighet att lämna relevanta **referenser**.

**Meriterande**
---------------


Det är meriterande om du även har:

* **IREB-certifiering** eller motsvarande.
* Erfarenhet från ledande roller eller befattningar.
* Praktisk erfarenhet och god förståelse för testarbete.
* Erfarenhet som kravanalytiker inom större offentliga organisationer.
* Erfarenhet av etablerade projekt-, förvaltnings- och styrningsmodeller.
* God förståelse för och erfarenhet av **agila arbetssätt**.

**Arbetsform**
--------------


Uppdraget bedrivs i projektform och arbetet sker **hybrid**, med arbete på plats hos kunden enligt överenskommelse med projektledningen samt möjlighet till distansarbete.


Möten och workshops genomförs både på plats och digitalt via Microsoft Teams.

title: Product AI Engineer to Modity
description:
Modity is helping shape the next generation of the energy market by combining deep market expertise with technology, data analytics, AI and innovation. Modity is now building a product organization focused on scalable digital products, intelligent services and new ways of creating customer value. As Product AI Engineer, you will play a key role in building, developing and delivering Modity’s digital and AI-driven products—from early prototypes and MVPs to production-ready solutions and continuous product development. This is an opportunity to combine hands-on product development with modern AI technology and create tangible value for Modity’s customers and business.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE**


Modity operates in an energy industry undergoing rapid change, where AI, connected data, automation and evolving customer needs are creating new opportunities. The role is part of Modity’s new product organization, where digital and AI-driven products are developed and brought into production.


As Product AI Engineer, you will turn prioritized product initiatives and business needs into functional digital and AI-driven products. You will use the technical platforms, AI capabilities, components and ways of working established by the Lead AI Engineer Agentic Systems.


The role complements the Lead AI Engineer Agentic Systems by applying the AI capabilities, agents, technical tools and frameworks that are being developed across Modity. You will work closely with the Product Owner and Lead AI Engineer Agentic Systems, with a clear focus on practical product development—from prototype and MVP to production, follow-up and continuous improvement.


This role does not include personnel responsibility.

### **Responsibilities**

* Translate prioritized product initiatives and business needs into functional technical solutions and products.
* Develop full-stack and backend functionality, including the APIs and system integrations required by the products.
* Implement and configure AI-, LLM- and agent-based functionality using established technical guidelines, platforms and components.
* Use, integrate and contribute to improving the AI capabilities, agents, components and tools established by the Lead AI Engineer Agentic Systems.
* Implement and configure the data flows, integrations and technical components required for the products being developed.
* Rapidly develop and evaluate prototypes and MVPs to test product ideas, usability and business value.
* Take responsibility for technical implementation, testing, production deployment, monitoring and continuous product development.
* Ensure that solutions are robust, secure, scalable and maintainable over time.
* Collaborate closely with the Product Owner, Lead AI Engineer Agentic Systems, project teams, business stakeholders and other relevant functions.

### **WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* A relevant post-secondary technical education or equivalent professional experience.
* Experience in full-stack and/or backend development, including APIs and system integrations.
* Experience developing and implementing AI-, LLM- or agent-based functionality.
* Experience taking products from prototype and MVP to production, including testing, deployment and continuous development.
* A strong product mindset and an ability to move from complicated challanges to simple solutions
* A good understanding of data flows, platform architecture, information security and scalability.
* Experience working pragmatically and iteratively in agile, cross-functional teams while balancing speed, quality and long-term sustainability.
* An interest in and ability to understand Modity’s business, customer needs and the energy market.
* Strong initiative, problem-solving, communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to turn ideas into results.
* Excellent written and spoken English.

### **It is an advantage if you have**

* Experience from the energy industry or another data-intensive and business-critical environment.
* Experience from start-up/scale-up organizations or industries where technology and data are central to the business.
* Experience working with AI agents, RAG solutions, model integrations or modern AI development frameworks.
* Experience with cloud environments, DevOps practices and monitoring solutions for production systems.
* Knowledge of Swedish or another Scandinavian language.

### **Personal qualities**


To succeed in this role, you are curious, pragmatic and solution-oriented, with a strong ability to turn ideas and business needs into working products. You enjoy hands-on development and are comfortable moving between rapid prototyping, technical implementation and the continuous improvement of production solutions.


You take initiative, work independently and drive your responsibilities forward while collaborating closely with product owners, technical specialists, project teams and business stakeholders. You can balance speed with quality and long-term maintainability and understand when to test an idea quickly and when a solution requires greater robustness and scalability.

### **ABOUT THE CLIENT**


Modity operates in the energy industry and helps energy companies navigate a rapidly changing market driven by AI, connected data, automation and evolving customer expectations. The company combines deep market expertise with technology, analytics and innovation to create new digital products and intelligent services.


The next step is to build the product and AI capabilities that enable Modity to develop a new generation of scalable digital products, intelligent services and new ways of creating customer value.


Modity is currently in a phase of development where new technical capabilities, ways of working and products are being established to create new forms of customer value and help shape the future energy market. This creates an opportunity to join at an early stage and have a real influence on how these capabilities, products and ways of working are shaped.

### **ABOUT THE EMPLOYMENT**


This position is a direct hire, and you will be employed directly by Modity.

* Start date: To be agreed
* Location: Lund (Hybride)
* Contact person: Sofia Krook, sofia.krook@friday.se
